fusions.name: Whipcrack Relay
fusions.desc: A lash that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Cast Shackle
fusions.desc: Throws a shackle at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hauled Up Short
fusions.desc: Strings a line of links 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that pulls every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 25% slower for 2 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Paying Out Links
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
